feature_name: Allow default factories of private attributes to take validated model data
description: Extend PrivateAttr default_factory so the factory callable can optionally accept a dict of already-validated model data (public fields and earlier private attrs), matching the existing capability on regular Field defaults. This allows private attributes to be computed from validated public field values during model construction.
functional_requirements: Allow PrivateAttr default_factory callables to optionally accept validated model data as a parameter
Ensure the factory receives both public fields and previously-set private attributes
Maintain backward compatibility for existing default_factory callables that take no arguments
Add a shared utility function for resolving default values across both Field and PrivateAttr
Add comprehensive test coverage for the new default_factory behavior
